title: Shop: Mounts, Barding, Saddles, Drawn Vehicles
content:
Want to craft an item yourself? Ask DM how!



Barding 

- PHB p229

Barding is armor designed for a mount. Any type of armor on the Armor table can be purchased as barding. The cost is four times the normal cost, and it weighs twice as much.


Saddles 

- PHB p229

A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle. A Military Saddle gives Advantage on any ability check you make to remain mounted. An Exotic Saddle is required for riding an aquatic or a flying mount.
